kevinXuPrinciples: All in on one stock at a time — concentration makes the return
Shares only — no options, no crypto, no margin (nothing that can go to zero overnight)
Real companies — quality businesses people ignore, not memes
Buy near support with a real near-term catalyst (days–weeks)
Never chase a stock that already ran
Sell into strength around +20–30% / before rumor becomes fully priced news
If it is good enough to screenshot, it is good enough to sell
Watch like a hawk while in; rotate to the next overlooked setup
Earnings are a coin flip — do not YOLO the print unless the setup is sentiment + support, not a DCF
Judge only the Agentic cash book
